articles.title: Getting started with NSBiz
articles.summary: Start the free NSBiz in a browser or install it: add your business, try the sample data, learn the menu, and know where your data is kept.

articles.title: How to install NSBiz
articles.summary: Install the free NSBiz on Windows, Mac or Android from Chrome or Edge, add it to an iPhone home screen, and fix a missing Install button.

articles.title: First-run setup of the installed App
articles.summary: The three steps of the installed NSBiz setup: type of business, business details with GSTIN fill, and the features switched on for you.

articles.title: Additional features: switch screens on or off
articles.summary: Switch NSBiz features on or off per business: stock, manufacturing, accounts, GST and industry tools. Off only hides; no data is deleted.

articles.title: Trade packs: start your trade with one tap
articles.summary: Trade packs add a ready item list with HSN or SAC and GST rate, document defaults and home boxes for kirana, salon, clinic and more. You see it first; remove it any time.

articles.title: The dashboard: your business at a glance
articles.summary: What every tile on NSBiz dashboard means: sales today and this month, to receive, to pay, cash in hand, bank and UPI, oldest dues.

articles.title: Make any document inside the App
articles.summary: Open the invoice, quotation, receipt and other makers inside NSBiz with + New document, Open and Convert, and come back with Back.

articles.title: Search everything and keyboard shortcuts
articles.summary: Keyboard shortcuts for every screen and document in NSBiz: Tally-style F keys, Alt keys, Alt+G codes and Ctrl K search.

articles.title: Quick entry: sale bills, purchase bills, payments and expenses by keyboard
articles.card: Quick entry: bills, payments and expenses by keyboard
articles.summary: Quick entry in NSBiz: five everyday entries in one box, typed with the keyboard. Enter moves on, Ctrl+S saves and starts the next one.

articles.title: My day: what needs you today, month end, business health and reminders
articles.card: My day: today, month end, health, reminders
articles.summary: My day lists overdue bills, cheques, low stock and tax dates; Month end is a checklist with your figures; Business health scores cash, collections and margin.

articles.title: All tools by job: find any tool inside the App
articles.summary: Every free Nivesh Sahayak tool in one screen of the App, grouped by job: sell and bill, buy and spend, money in and out, GST and tax, staff and rent, stock, books.

articles.title: The Sales screen: bills, dues and conversions
articles.summary: Use the Sales screen of NSBiz: search bills, filter Due or Paid, record a payment against a bill, and convert quotations to invoices.

articles.title: Record money received against bills
articles.summary: Record a customer payment in NSBiz: tick the bills it settles, handle part payments, advances, TDS cut by the customer and cheques.

articles.title: Record money paid to suppliers
articles.summary: Record a payment to a supplier in NSBiz: tick the purchase bills it pays, deduct TDS, choose cash, UPI or bank, and print the payment voucher.

articles.title: Enter a purchase bill or a purchase return
articles.summary: Enter a supplier bill in NSBiz: supplier GSTIN and state, items with HSN and GST, paid now or on credit, bill photo, and purchase returns.

articles.title: Scan a supplier bill photo into a purchase bill
articles.summary: Take a photo of a supplier bill and NSBiz reads it on your device into a purchase bill draft. You check every field before saving. English or Hindi.

articles.title: Order again, same bill again, and special prices for a party
articles.summary: Repeat a supplier's last order with one tap, make the same sale bill again, and keep a customer's or supplier's own price list so the right rate fills in by itself.

articles.title: Record expenses
articles.summary: Record everyday expenses in NSBiz: expense type, paid by or on credit, GST included and input tax credit, and how they reach profit and loss.

articles.title: Enter opening balances when you start
articles.summary: Start NSBiz mid-year: enter what customers owed, what you owed suppliers, cash in hand and bank balance on your start date.

articles.title: Repeating bills for monthly customers
articles.summary: Set an invoice to repeat every month in Nivesh Sahayak and make the due copies from the App's Repeating bills screen with one tap. Nothing is made without you.

articles.title: Dues, ageing and WhatsApp reminders
articles.summary: See who owes you in NSBiz, split by 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ days, with credit limits, due dates and a ready WhatsApp reminder.

articles.title: Party ledger, statement and balance confirmation
articles.summary: Open any customer or supplier ledger in NSBiz: Dr/Cr running balance, bill-wise view, balance confirmation letter, PDF, Excel, WhatsApp.

articles.title: Group reports
articles.summary: Use party groups in NSBiz: group summary with opening, debit, credit and closing, dues by group with ageing, and top customers.

articles.title: Cash book, bank book and day book
articles.summary: See every cash and bank entry with a running balance in NSBiz, record cash deposited or withdrawn, and print or export the cash book.

articles.title: Cheques received and given
articles.summary: Record cheques in NSBiz, track post-dated and uncleared cheques, mark them cleared or bounced, and see bills become due again after a bounce.

articles.title: How stock works in the App
articles.summary: How NSBiz keeps stock from bills: godown stock, stock transfers, batches near expiry, serial or IMEI search, and the stock site.

articles.title: Production entries and bill of materials
articles.summary: Make a bill of materials, record production that uses raw material and adds finished goods at cost, with multi-level BOM, versions and by-products.

articles.title: Job work and the ITC-04 return
articles.summary: Track goods sent to job workers in NSBiz, the one and three year limits, goods received back with charges, and the ITC-04 working.

articles.title: Orders and pending goods
articles.summary: Track every sales and purchase order line in NSBiz: delivered, billed, pending, overdue; pick open lines into challans and bills; close the rest short.

articles.title: Receipt notes, goods back and landed cost
articles.card: Receipt notes, goods back and landed cost
articles.summary: Record goods received before the bill, goods returned by customers or sent back to suppliers, and add freight to the cost of the goods in NSBiz.

articles.title: Journal entries
articles.summary: Make a journal entry in NSBiz when no bill or payment fits: debit and credit lines, accounts and parties, with worked examples.

articles.title: Capital, drawings and loans
articles.summary: Record money the owner puts in or takes out, loans taken and repaid, and loans given, in NSBiz, with interest and the cash limit.

articles.title: Staff, salary and loans
articles.summary: Put salary slips, PF, ESI, professional tax and TDS, staff advances and loan EMIs into your books with NSBiz, and see what is still to pay.

articles.title: Attendance, PF return and ESI
articles.summary: Mark staff attendance, send paid days to the salary slip, and make the PF ECR file, the ESI contribution sheet and both challan workings in NSBiz.

articles.title: Process salary for all staff
articles.summary: Run salary for all staff at once in NSBiz: pay heads, structures, leave, PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS for the year, bank sheet, payslips and full and final.

articles.title: TDS on bills and TDS returns
articles.card: TDS on bills and TDS returns
articles.summary: Cut TDS when you book a bill or expense in NSBiz, with yearly limits per party, record TDS challans and get the quarterly TDS return working (Form 140, 138, 144).

articles.title: Fixed assets and depreciation
articles.summary: Add machines, computers, furniture and vehicles to the Nivesh Sahayak fixed assets register; see Schedule II and income-tax depreciation; post it to the books.

articles.title: Trial balance: styles and how to read it
articles.summary: Read the Nivesh Sahayak trial balance: closing or detailed style, group-wise, account-wise or ledger-wise, with stock, and what to do if it does not agree.

articles.title: Final accounts: profit and loss and balance sheet
articles.summary: Make the trading and profit and loss account and balance sheet in NSBiz, in T format or Schedule III, with previous-year figures and stock value.

articles.title: Manufacturing account
articles.summary: Read the Nivesh Sahayak manufacturing account: raw material used, factory expenses, work in progress, by-products and cost of goods made, with an example.

articles.title: Partnership firm and LLP accounts
articles.summary: Set partners, profit shares, interest on capital and salary in Nivesh Sahayak and read the appropriation account and partners' capital accounts.

articles.title: Income and expenditure, receipts and payments (trusts and schools)
articles.summary: For trusts, societies, NGOs and schools: income and expenditure account, receipts and payments account and capital fund in NSBiz.

articles.title: Year end: check, close and start the next year
articles.card: Year end and closing a year
articles.summary: Close a financial year in NSBiz: year-end summary, checks before closing, read-only closed years, and how numbers and balances continue.

articles.title: Reports to Excel for you and your accountant
articles.summary: Download Excel reports from NSBiz: sales register, purchase register, dues, stock summary, party statements, items, edit history, all in one.

articles.title: GST work from your App data
articles.summary: How NSBiz data feeds GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B matching, CMP-08, e-invoice and e-way bill tools, and what you file yourself on the GST portal.

articles.title: Where your data is kept, and how to keep it safe
articles.summary: Your Nivesh Sahayak data stays in your own browser: the one data home shared by all tools, backups, one auto save on a computer, and moving to a new device.

articles.title: Check an IFSC code inside the App
articles.summary: Check an IFSC code before you put bank details on a bill or save a party: bank, branch, address, MICR code, and the new code when a bank has merged.

articles.title: Find or check a PIN code inside the App
articles.summary: Check a 6-digit PIN code or find the PIN code of a place inside NSBiz: post offices, district and state, for addresses on bills and e-way bills.

articles.title: Work out the distance between two places inside the App
articles.summary: Work out the distance between two towns inside NSBiz: road kilometres, driving time, straight line and fuel cost, for e-way bills and freight.

articles.title: Income tax planner: advance tax and which ITR
articles.summary: Estimate the year's income from your books, compare old and new regime, plan the four advance tax instalments, find the ITR form that fits and copy the figures.

articles.title: Donations and members: receipts, donor register, member dues
articles.card: Donations and members (trusts, NGOs, gurdwaras, temples)
articles.summary: Make donation receipts with the trust PAN and 80G number, keep a donor register and member subscription ledger, see fund-wise totals and print yearly donor statements.

articles.title: Warranty and service due
articles.summary: Add warranty months to bill lines, see every item by warranty end and service due, look up by serial, IMEI or phone, remind customers on WhatsApp and open a job card.

articles.title: MSME payables: bills to micro and small suppliers
articles.summary: Mark each supplier micro, small or other, see bills past the MSMED Act payment limit, and print the 31 March list of unpaid bills whose tax deduction is at risk.

articles.title: Limits helper: composition, e-invoice, e-way bill
articles.summary: See where your own sales stand against the composition scheme limits, the Rs 5 crore e-invoice limit and the Rs 50,000 e-way bill limit, with the official links.

articles.title: Backup health on My day
articles.summary: My day shows how many days ago you saved a backup file and whether the auto-save folder is on, with a one-tap Back up now button.

articles.title: Bank statement import
articles.summary: Open the CSV or Excel statement from net banking, match each line with parties, bills and expense heads, and post receipts, payments and expenses to your books in one go.

articles.title: Masters: every ledger, group, item and setting in one place
articles.summary: One Masters screen for ledgers, account groups, voucher types, stock items, stock groups, units, banks, transporters, vehicles and businesses.

articles.title: Several bank accounts: one bank book for each
articles.summary: Add more bank accounts in NSBiz, set each opening balance, pick the bank on every UPI or cheque entry and see one bank book per account.

articles.title: Transporters and vehicles: typed once, filled on every bill
articles.summary: Save transporters and vehicles once in NSBiz; typing a vehicle number on a bill, challan, bilty or e-way bill then fills transporter and driver.

articles.title: Entry screens: sale, purchase, receipt, payment, contra and more
articles.summary: Every NSBiz voucher opens full screen beside the side menu: F8 sale, F9 purchase, F6 receipt, F5 payment, F4 contra, F7 journal, F10 expense.

articles.title: Cancel a voucher instead of deleting it
articles.summary: Cancel a wrong bill in NSBiz: it keeps its number, posts nothing to books, stock or GST, prints CANCELLED and shows in GSTR-1 as cancelled.

articles.title: Working period and drill-down in reports
articles.summary: Pick the period once (Alt+F2) and every NSBiz report follows; click any figure to go down to the group, the ledger and the voucher, Esc to come back.

articles.title: Debtors, creditors, registers and summaries
articles.summary: Sundry Debtors and Sundry Creditors, Sales and Purchase Registers, Voucher Registers, Cash and Bank Summary, Exception Reports and Print Many Vouchers in NSBiz.

articles.title: Custom fields and remembered entries
articles.summary: Add your own fields (PO no., Site, Size, Route) to parties, items and vouchers in NSBiz: required, printed, copied on conversion, in registers; plus remembered entries.

articles.title: Bill-wise: money on account and Adjust bills
articles.card: Bill-wise: on account and Adjust bills
articles.summary: Choose how money is set against bills in NSBiz: oldest bill first or strict bill-wise like Tally. Keep money on account and adjust it against bills later.

articles.title: Interest on late payment and credit limits
articles.card: Interest on late payment and credit limits
articles.summary: Work out interest on overdue bills party-wise and bill-wise, make a debit note or journal for it, and stop or warn credit sales over the limit or with late bills.

articles.title: Receipt and Payment with any ledgers
articles.card: Receipt and Payment with any ledgers
articles.summary: Record one receipt or payment that touches several parties and ledgers, Tally style: one cash or bank account and any number of lines, each with its bills.

articles.title: Several sales and purchase ledgers
articles.summary: Book sales and purchases into separate ledgers such as Sales - Local or Sales - Interstate, per bill, line or item, shown in profit and loss and Tally.
